statement: An employer must automatically enrol new employees aged over 18 and under 65 in KiwiSaver unless they are already KiwiSaver members, reporting each eligible new employee to Inland Revenue on the New employee and KiwiSaver details form (IR346K).
caveat: Inland Revenue lists categories of employees exempt from automatic enrolment, and enrolled employees have an opt-out window; the duties sit in the KiwiSaver Act 2006 (legislation.govt.nz answers automated fetches with an AWS WAF challenge, recorded 2026-10-23). Check the live guidance before onboarding.
